item.title: Real-Time Video Post-Processing on Android with OpenGL ES Fragment Shaders
item.description: Every modern video player on Android eventually does the same thing: feeds compressed video into MediaCodec, lets the hardware decoder turn it into raw frames, and pushes those frames to a Surface for display. The entire process is optimized to be invisible. And for 99% of use cases, that is exactly what you want.
